title: A Culturally-diverse Multilingual Multimodal Video Benchmark & Model

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the accuracy of Video Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on multiple-choice and open-ended visual question answering tasks across 14 high- and low-resource languages and 9 language scripts to identify performance disparities.

Evaluating model performance on a manually curated benchmark of videos spanning 8 culturally specific categories (e.g., local festivals, foods, rituals) and conducting error analysis to identify gaps in cultural understanding and instances of prior knowledge bias.
